title: Cekura (YC F24) Is Hiring
summary: Cekura AI, a Y Combinator Winter 2024 batch company, is hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer to work directly with enterprise clients on AI implementation and deployment. The role focuses on bridging technical solutions with customer business needs.
problem_solved: Helps enterprises implement and deploy AI solutions by providing technical expertise directly at the customer site.
why_valuable: Forward Deployed Engineers are critical for successful AI product adoption as they translate complex technical capabilities into real business value for customers.
